abilities.name: Life Tap
abilities.description: 222 Life Gul'dan does not regenerate Mana. Activate to restore 25% of Gul'dan's Mana.

fields.notes: Cannot be used if Gul'dan is at maximum Mana or if using it would be lethal. Does not dismount.

abilities.name: Fel Flame
abilities.description: Release a wave of flame, dealing 210 damage to enemies.

fields.notes: 1) Area grows from 1.0 to its maximum radius over 0.5625 seconds in 1.04 increments. Casting Fel Flame sets Gul'dan's Basic Attack cooldown to 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Drain Life
abilities.description: Drain the life from an enemy over 3 seconds, dealing 132 damage per second and healing Gul'dan for 188 Health per second.; 10 / 0.5

fields.notes: Ability is interrupted if the target moves 3.5 units past its cast range. Can be canceled after 0.5 seconds by reactivating the Ability, or issuing a move or stop command.

abilities.name: Corruption
abilities.description: Call forth three bursts of shadow energy, dealing 204 damage over 6 seconds. Corruption can stack up to 3 times on an enemy.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Damage over Time
fields.notes: Cast point marks the center of the first burst. Can only stack up to 3 times per target (cannot be modified by any Talents). Damage over time ticks individually for each burst. Each hit extends the duration of all stacks to 6 seconds (because the tick rate is only once per second, this only matters for each full second the stack has been extended by).

abilities.name: Horrify
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds deal 120 damage to enemy Heroes in an area and Fear them for 2 seconds. While Feared, Heroes are Silenced and forced to run away from Horrify's center.; 90; 80; Heroic

abilities.name: Rain of Destruction
abilities.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a rain of meteors in an area for 7 seconds. Each meteor deals 165 damage in a small area.; 70; 80; Heroic

fields.notes: 1) Meteors' spawn locations are randomly chosen (allowing repetitions) from 44 predetermined locations: 1 in the center, 8 locations are spaced evenly on a 3 radius circle, 15 locations are spaced evenly on a 6 radius circle and the remaining 20 locations are spaced evenly on a 9 radius circle. Interrupting the cast in any way puts it on a 10-second cooldown. Gul'dan can interrupt the channel by issuing a "move" or "stop" command.

talents.name: Pursuit of Flame
talents.description: quest Hit 30 enemy Heroes with Fel Flame. Permanently increase Fel Flame's area by 33%.

fields.notes: Increases the radius growth rate to 1.14 per tick.

_raw_fields: quest Hit 30 enemy Heroes with Fel Flame. Permanently increase Fel Flame's area by 33%.

talents.name: Chaotic Energy
talents.description: Increases the cast range of Drain Life by 25% and the healing provided by Regen Globes by 50%. quest Gather 15 Regen Globes. Basic Ability Mana costs are permanently reduced by 20.
_raw_fields: Increases the cast range of Drain Life by 25% and the healing provided by Regen Globes by 50%. quest Gather 15 Regen Globes. Basic Ability Mana costs are permanently reduced by 20.

talents.name: Echoed Corruption
talents.description: quest Hit enemy Heroes with Corruption. After hitting 40 Heroes, Corruption gains new functionality. After the third strike, Corruption strikes 3 times in the opposite direction. Reward After 85 hits, Corruption heals for 100% of the damage dealt.

fields.notes: A target can still only have up to 3 stacks of Corruption on it (see notes under that Basic Ability). Because of the length of the delay between impacts, all hits above 3 from Corruption once this Talent reward is earned will add 1 second to 1 stack of Corruption each (in other words 1 damage tick).

_raw_fields: quest Hit enemy Heroes with Corruption. After hitting 40 Heroes, Corruption gains new functionality. After the third strike, Corruption strikes 3 times in the opposite direction. Reward After 85 hits, Corruption heals for 100% of the damage dealt.

talents.name: Health Funnel
talents.description: Drain Life's cooldown recharges 100% faster while it is channeling. If an enemy dies while under the effect of Drain Life, the cooldown is instantly refreshed.

fields.notes: Cooldown gets reset if the enemy dies from anything within 1.5 seconds after being affected by Drain Life (Summon timed life expiration does not apply cooldown reset).

_raw_fields: Drain Life's cooldown recharges 100% faster while it is channeling. If an enemy dies while under the effect of Drain Life, the cooldown is instantly refreshed.

talents.name: Improved Life Tap
talents.description: Increase the Mana restored by Life Tap to 40%.
_raw_fields: Increase the Mana restored by Life Tap to 40%.

talents.name: Consume Soul
talents.description: Cooldown 25 Active Instantly kill an enemy Minion and heal for 365 Health. Stores 3 charges.
_raw_fields: Cooldown 25 Active Instantly kill an enemy Minion and heal for 365 Health. Stores 3 charges.

talents.name: Bound by Shadow
talents.description: Each enemy Hero hit with Fel Flame reduces the cooldown of Corruption by 1.75 seconds.
_raw_fields: Each enemy Hero hit with Fel Flame reduces the cooldown of Corruption by 1.75 seconds.

talents.name: Curse of Exhaustion
talents.description: Drain Life deals 50% more damage and Slows the target's Movement Speed by 40%.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Drain Life 's damage.

_raw_fields: Drain Life deals 50% more damage and Slows the target's Movement Speed by 40%.

talents.name: Hunger for Power
talents.description: Increases Spell Power by 15% but reduces healing received from allies by 25%.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing dealt modifier, Healing received modifier
fields.notes: Healing from Healing Fountains, Regeneration Globes and Biotic Emitters is also reduced. Self-healing from Gul'dan's Abilities and Talents is not reduced, and is in fact increased due to Spell Power. Spell Power from Hunger for Power stacks additively with itself and other sources of Spell Power as well as other offensive damage modifiers and healing dealt modifiers affecting Gul'dan.

_raw_fields: Increases Spell Power by 15% but reduces healing received from allies by 25%.

talents.name: Horrify
talents.description: Cooldown 80 After a short delay, deal 120 damage and fear enemy Heroes in the area for 2 seconds.
_raw_fields: Cooldown 80 After a short delay, deal 120 damage and fear enemy Heroes in the area for 2 seconds.

talents.name: Rain of Destruction
talents.description: Cooldown 70 After 1.5 seconds, summon a rain of meteors in an area for 7 seconds. Each meteor deals 165 damage in a small area.
_raw_fields: Cooldown 70 After 1.5 seconds, summon a rain of meteors in an area for 7 seconds. Each meteor deals 165 damage in a small area.

talents.name: Fel Armor
talents.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Fel Flame grants 50 Spell Armor for 2.5 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 50%.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself or other positive Armor effects.

_raw_fields: Hitting an enemy Hero with Fel Flame grants 50 Spell Armor for 2.5 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 50%.

talents.name: Harvest Life
talents.description: Drain Life heals for 75% more Health when used on Heroes.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with effects that affect healing dealt, and multiplicatively with effects that affect healing received by Gul'dan.

_raw_fields: Drain Life heals for 75% more Health when used on Heroes.

talents.name: Dark Bargain
talents.description: Guldan's maximum Health is permanently increased by 40% but his Death Respawn time is increased by 10 seconds.
_raw_fields: Guldan's maximum Health is permanently increased by 40% but his Death Respawn time is increased by 10 seconds.

talents.name: Healthstone
talents.description: Cooldown 45 Active Activate to heal for 25% of Gul'dan's maximum Health.

fields.notes: Cannot be used when Gul'dan is at maximum Health.

_raw_fields: Cooldown 45 Active Activate to heal for 25% of Gul'dan's maximum Health.

talents.name: Rampant Hellfire
talents.description: Fel Flame's damage is increased by 12% for 5 seconds when hitting an enemy Hero. This can stack up to 5 times.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers affecting Fel Flame 's damage.

_raw_fields: Fel Flame's damage is increased by 12% for 5 seconds when hitting an enemy Hero. This can stack up to 5 times.

talents.name: Ruinous Affliction
talents.description: Corruption deals an additional 70 damage on impact. If the enemy is hit by all three strikes, the third strike deals 242 damage.

fields.notes: Three hit damage is dealt instead of the initial damage of the third hit.

_raw_fields: Corruption deals an additional 70 damage on impact. If the enemy is hit by all three strikes, the third strike deals 242 damage.

talents.name: Darkness Within
talents.description: Dealing 600 damage to enemy Heroes causes the next cast of Life Tap to cost no Health and grant Gul'dan 25% Spell Power for 5 seconds.

fields.notes: Stored damage does not scale upon level up, but fully charged effect remains activatable. Spell Power from Darkness Within stacks additively with itself and other sources of Spell Power as well as other offensive damage modifiers and healing dealt modifiers affecting Gul'dan.

_raw_fields: Dealing 600 damage to enemy Heroes causes the next cast of Life Tap to cost no Health and grant Gul'dan 25% Spell Power for 5 seconds.

talents.name: Haunt
talents.description: Increases the duration of Horrify by 1 second, and while Feared, enemies lose 20 Armor, causing them to take 20% increased damage.
_raw_fields: Increases the duration of Horrify by 1 second, and while Feared, enemies lose 20 Armor, causing them to take 20% increased damage.

talents.name: Deep Impact
talents.description: Rain of Destruction Slows enemies' Movement Speed by 90% for 0.5 seconds.
_raw_fields: Rain of Destruction Slows enemies' Movement Speed by 90% for 0.5 seconds.

talents.name: Demonic Circle
talents.description: Cooldown 60 Active Summon a Demonic Circle at your location. Activate to teleport to the Demonic Circle. Summon Demonic Circle Teleport to Demonic Circle

fields.notes: Requires an active Demonic Circle. Active Demonic Circles are removed when Teleport to Demonic Circle is used.
